regenerationTargetVerdict.question: The recorded counts are mutually incompatible - active chain 429 public relations, committed contract 402, linked Supabase project 609. Nothing in the repository records which target the contract is generated FROM, and the prior wave deliberately shipped the regeneration capability unused on the reasoning that a working command aimed at a wrong target invites the deletion CP-016 exists to prevent. Which target is it?
regenerationTargetVerdict.verdict: CHAIN-BUILT. lib/database.types.ts was generated from a database onto which the active numbered migration chain had been applied in version order, at a watermark that stops at 20260910000001_get_active_organizer_account_for_org.sql. It was NOT generated from the linked Supabase project, and it was NOT generated from a hosted staging or production target.
regenerationTargetVerdict.confidence: measured, not inferred. The claim rests on a strict-subset result that is reproduced by two independent instruments plus an independent re-derivation of the contract side, and on a contiguous staleness watermark with no exception.
regenerationTargetVerdict.decision: The admissible regeneration source is a CHAIN-BUILT target, and only a chain-built one. Concretely: a database created by the Supabase CLI from THIS repository's supabase/migrations/ (a fresh local stack, or an isolated staging project onto which the chain has been applied one migration at a time under CP-051 with each apply recorded). --linked is PERMANENTLY DISQUALIFIED as a generation source. --project-id is admissible only for a project whose applied history is itself the chain.

disqualifiedSources.verdict: PERMANENTLY DISQUALIFIED as a generation source
disqualifiedSources.why: It is a DIFFERENT DATABASE, not a stale copy of this one. Measured in Wave 35: 609 relations / 8,020 columns / 151 callables, against a 429-relation chain and a 402-relation contract. Regenerating from it would DELETE 78 relations, 112 columns and 27 callables that the committed contract declares, and ADD 285 relations of which 276 are created by no active migration. The 78 deletions span 26 migrations from 20250115000000 to 20260908130000 with no contiguous cutoff. A source that deletes coverage is not a stale source, and CP-016 exists precisely to stop a regeneration from doing that silently.
disqualifiedSources.corroboration: The disqualification does not depend on the Wave 35 measurement alone. The committed contract has ZERO out-of-band relations, columns and callables against the active chain (regenerationTargetVerdict.evidence). A target with 78 relations and 112 columns the chain never creates is by definition NOT the contract's source, whatever its size. A single independent property of the contract decides this.
disqualifiedSources.linkProvenanceCaveat: The 609/8,020/151 figures are carried forward from the Wave 35 read-only probe recorded in the DB-008 task record and in HF-DB-008-REGENERATION-UNREACHABLE-AND-LINKED-TARGET-IS-A-DIFFERENT-DATABASE. single_examined_exception.resolution: INSTRUMENT ARTEFACT, not watermark breakage. wiringRequest.theAssertionMustBeThatScenariosRan: Do NOT assert on the exit code alone. The runner's summary counter is wrong: it prints `ran 9, skipped 1, failed 0` after executing EIGHT harnesses. `ran` is incremented before the per-harness skip check, so a harness that printed `SKIP view-delta` and did nothing is still counted as ran.
